text.Port of Call:
How to Play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 3 trade. As an Outpost the Port of Call protects your bases and your HQ with a quite powerful 6 points. Scrapping the card gives you a draw a card and you may destroy a target base.
 Strategy ==
The Port of Call stongest asset is the double benefit you get from scrapping the card. Draw a card and destroying a target base can enhance your attack and its prolonging your turn. That can be a game changer if played at a opportune moment. Adding 3 trade to your buy options is also powerful. With a cost of 6 a good card to buy at any time in the game.
